import statistics

    1942: 3262800,

years = sorted(raw_thousands.keys())
assert len(years) == 14, 'should have 14 years'
assert years == list(range(1929, 1943)), 'years must be 1929-1942 inclusive'

# Convert to billions of nominal dollars
Y = [raw_thousands[y] / 1_000_000 for y in years]  # divide by 1,000,000
X = [float(y) for y in years]

# OLS regression: slope = sum((x-xbar)(y-ybar)) / sum((x-xbar)^2)
#               intercept = ybar - slope * xbar
xbar = statistics.mean(X)
ybar = statistics.mean(Y)
slope = sum((x - xbar) * (y - ybar) for x, y in zip(X, Y)) / sum((x - xbar) ** 2 for x in X)
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print('=== OLS Results ===')
print(f'n = {len(X)}')
print(f'Years: {years[0]} to {years[-1]}')
print(f'xbar = {xbar}')
print(f'ybar (mean receipts in billions) = {ybar}')

print(f'slope   = {slope:.15f}  =>  rounded = {round(slope, 3)}')
print(f'intercept = {intercept:.15f}  =>  rounded = {round(intercept, 3)}')

# Format: 3 decimal places for both, as required
ans = f'[{round(slope, 3)}, {round(intercept, 3)}]'
print(f'Final answer: {ans}')
"
